en: Black‑and‑white image of a landscaped city park with flowerbeds and trimmed hedges surrounding a central statue. The statue depicts a man in a cloak holding a sword, mounted on a high pedestal decorated with a heraldic shield. Behind the park stand multi‑storey 19th‑century apartment buildings with mansard roofs. The name "Tadeusz Kościuszko" is visible on the base of the monument.
